wages.text: She said she would fight for fair wages and workers’ right to bargain collectively.
wages.quote: And it means fighting for fair wages and the right for workers to collectively bargain.

debt.text: She opposed raising the retirement age or cutting or privatizing Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: I oppose efforts to raise the retirement age, or to cut or privatize our social safety net.

schools.text: She said she would work to strengthen Michigan public schools and support classroom educators.
schools.quote: That’s why I will never stop working to strengthen Michigan public schools to make sure our students are prepared and ready to engage in a 21st-century economy.

immigration.text: In a candidate questionnaire, she called for due-process protections, access to counsel where appropriate, and a meaningful opportunity to be heard.
immigration.quote: No person should be deprived of liberty or property without fair procedures, access to counsel where appropriate, and a meaningful opportunity to be heard.

guns.text: She said she supports universal background checks, safe-storage laws, and red-flag laws.
guns.quote: I’m proud to have been recognized by Moms Demand Action as a Gun Sense Candidate for my commitment to common-sense gun safety reforms like universal background checks, safe gun storage laws, and red flag laws.

abortion.text: She said the decision about whether and when to become a parent belongs to women and pledged to protect abortion rights.
abortion.quote: I will always protect a woman’s right to choose.

gender.text: She voted against H.R. 28, the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: She said she defends the Affordable Care Act and works to expand it.
health.quote: I vote to cap the cost of critical prescription drugs and insulin, and I defend the Affordable Care Act and work every day to expand on it.

energy.text: She supports renewable-energy investment while also calling for immediate use of U.S. oil reserves to lower energy costs.
energy.quote: We need to invest in renewable energy – and tap our nation’s oil reserves right now – to bring down the cost of energy.

voting.text: She called for federal legislation to expand vote-by-mail and early voting nationwide.
voting.quote: including: ending voter suppression and expanding vote-by-mail and early-vote nationwide; ending partisan gerrymandering; and protecting against attempts to subvert or overturn the results of our elections.

tax.text: Her campaign says she would cut taxes and reduce government spending to fight inflation.
tax.quote: Cut taxes and reduce government spending to fight inflation.

wages.text: She favors reducing regulations so small businesses can hire and offer competitive wages.
wages.quote: Slash onerous regulations (like healthcare rules) so small companies can hire more and pay competitive wages.

debt.text: Her campaign says she will protect Social Security while making health care more affordable.
debt.quote: She’ll put people before politics, fight to make healthcare more affordable, protect Social Security, work to bring good-paying jobs home, and stand up for greater accountability in Congress, including an end to insider trading by members of Congress.

schools.text: She says education funding should follow students to the school their parents choose.
schools.quote: I will protect the fundamental right of parents to direct their children’s medical care and education, ensuring funding follows the student to the school of their choice.

safety.text: She supports repealing what she calls soft-on-crime policies to strengthen enforcement against crime.
safety.quote: Stop illegal immigration and repeal soft-on-crime policies so our laws protect law-abiding Michigan families—not criminals.

immigration.text: She supports securing the border, enforcing immigration laws, and removing dangerous criminals who entered illegally.
immigration.quote: Secure the border and enforce immigration laws. Stop illegal immigration and human exploitation. Remove dangerous criminals who enter the country illegally.

health.text: She supports expanding healthcare choice and competition, including direct primary care and health savings accounts.
health.quote: Expand healthcare choice and competition to lower costs.

energy.text: She supports affordable, reliable energy and opposes mandates that raise utility bills.
energy.quote: Support an all-of-the-above energy strategy to keep energy affordable and reliable. Expand clean, dependable nuclear energy production. Oppose costly energy mandates that increase utility bills for families.

voting.text: She supports requiring photo identification to vote.
voting.quote: Restore trust in our democracy by securing our elections and requiring a valid photo ID to vote.

health.text: He said he would fight for tax-funded health care distribution and argued that health care should not be for profit.
health.quote: I would fight for tax funder healthcare distribution as far as prescription medication research and development largely relies on taxpayer funding

energy.text: He proposed a phased renewable-energy program beginning with federal buildings and expanding to other buildings.
energy.quote: I believe we should have a renewable energy phase program, where the first phase of the program is all federal buildings must be equipped with renewable power sources.
